name: Source
description: Represents an individual source, such as a book, journal article, or interview.
remarks: For more information, see Working with Bibliographies.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the add-in was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Source object.

properties.name: Tag
properties.description: Returns a String that represents an internal identifying label for a source. Read-only.

properties.name: Field
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the value of a field in a bibliography source. Read-only.

properties.name: XML
properties.description: Returns a String that represents the XML markup for a Source object. Read-only.

properties.name: Cited
properties.description: Returns a Boolean that represents whether a source has been cited in a document. Read-only.
